objective: Find and falsify a composable invariant that lowers exact Boolean tensor contraction cost for the hashed prime-field ECDLP network.

experiments.name: canonical_ir_equivalence_and_mutation_gate
experiments.hypothesis: A stable typed IR can round-trip every compared network without changing semantic counts, interfaces, witnesses, pins, or predicate parameters.

controls.aa: original IR serialized twice in independent processes
controls.positive: known tiny arithmetic and copy networks

experiments.instances: all production predicate tags plus exhaustive tiny composed fixtures
experiments.advance: all exact values equal and every mutation detected
experiments.falsifier: any unexplained semantic difference or undetected declared mutation

experiments.name: boundary_tensor_rank_census
experiments.hypothesis: Natural hashed networks have lower normalized balanced boundary-flattening rank than topology-preserving rewired nulls.

controls.negative: degree-preserving edge swaps within frozen cut classes, preserving local predicates, edges, interface, pins, cut width and per-vertex cut degree; conditioned and unconditioned panels

experiments.advance: registered paired rank and slope gaps on held-out cells with >=90% exact-rank completion
experiments.falsifier: equivalence interval around zero with passing controls and >=90% completion
experiments.claim_limit: finite-size mechanism lead, not subexponential complexity

experiments.name: sat_bdd_mechanism_triangulation
experiments.hypothesis: The boundary-rank signature found in E1 predicts lower complete search work for at least two exact Boolean solver representations on the same natural/null pairs.

controls.aa: byte-identical solver input and seed in a fresh process
controls.positive: unit-propagation and bounded-width families with hidden verified models
controls.negative: the conditioned and unconditioned E1 rewired nulls
controls.sham: variable and clause renaming with canonical inverse map

experiments.instances: the frozen E1 pairs only; no solver-specific instance selection
experiments.advance: natural/null complete-work ratio <=0.8 with corrected interval below 1 on the three largest sizes in two solver bundles, plus held-out rank/log-work association lower interval >=0.4
experiments.falsifier: effect is within A/A/sham spread, changes sign across bundles, or has no held-out association with exact rank
experiments.claim_limit: nominates only the tested solver/encoding bundles; does not establish a generic SAT advantage

experiments.name: local_fourier_partition_rank_census
experiments.hypothesis: The E1 gap is explained by a stable low-dimensional basis for repeated arithmetic/hash blocks and composes across blocks.

controls.aa: port-permuted equivalent block with canonical inverse permutation
controls.positive: copy, XOR, ripple-carry, and separable tensors with known spectra
controls.negative: arity- and acceptance-weight-matched random truth tables under the bounded arity cap

experiments.advance: a checked composition certificate predicts >=20% lower exact operations on four held-out sizes and the null does not
experiments.falsifier: rank saturates the ambient dimension under repeated composition or no global bound follows
experiments.claim_limit: local low rank alone is insufficient

experiments.name: certified_rewrite_and_order_search
experiments.hypothesis: Certified rewrites and contraction orders can expose the registered invariant and improve held-out exact work growth.

controls.aa: search disabled but full candidate replay path enabled
controls.positive: network family with a planted eliminable equality and known superior order

experiments.advance: >=2x exact-operation and live-state improvement on all three largest holdout sizes plus lower growth slope
experiments.falsifier: training gains disappear on holdout or any candidate lacks an exact equivalence certificate
experiments.claim_limit: constant-factor gain is engineering, not a new mechanism

experiments.name: structure_specific_exact_contraction_engine
experiments.hypothesis: A rank/Fourier-aware exact message engine lowers complete exact work and memory on the same canonical instances.

controls.aa: baseline wrapper duplicated in a fresh process
controls.external: fastest available exact tensor, BDD, or #SAT implementation accepting the same instances

experiments.advance: >=2x exact operations and peak memory on the two largest held-out sizes, every output equal, and lower growth slope
experiments.falsifier: advantage is within A/A spread, vanishes when setup/precision is charged, or fails on null/holdout
experiments.claim_limit: no asymptotic claim from four sizes

experiments.name: end_to_end_relation_oracle_gate
experiments.hypothesis: The registered invariant reduces complete verified relation-collection work after all failures, extraction, replay, and linear algebra are charged.

controls.aa: identical oracle rerun with fresh process layout
controls.positive: planted relations hidden from the oracle
controls.negative: same-size instances without the registered invariant

experiments.advance: complete-pipeline improvement on four increasing sizes and one unseen target family
experiments.falsifier: local contraction gain is erased by relation yield, retries, verification, or linear algebra
experiments.claim_limit: cryptanalytic progress only; asymptotic ECDLP claims require a proved family bound
